mode: Original Queue WebView login retained; no separate Chrome/CDP, no shop-tab architecture change
observedProblem: The live Sign in page can render its form inside a role=dialog card ('Login to Roblox' with 'Log In'), and the password field can stay disabled until the username is committed. The host treated every dialog as a human challenge and only filled both fields at once, so orders alternated between working and stopping at LOGIN_FORM_TIMEOUT / CUSTOMER_IDENTITY_VERIFICATION.
changes: A dialog that contains the password field is treated as the login form, not as a challenge; only dialogs without the login fields (or captcha frames) pause the job.
Fields are located by id when present and otherwise by autocomplete/name/placeholder, so the dialog layout without #login-username is still filled.
The submit control is resolved by exact label (Sign in / Log In / เข้าสู่ระบบ) inside the login dialog or form, and still fails closed when more than one candidate is visible.
Login is filled left then right: username first, then the password once it becomes editable, then submit; a password that never enables reports LOGIN_SUBMIT_TIMEOUT instead of silently waiting.

nodeTests.newCases: dialog layout without ids, password disabled until username, dialog not classified as challenge, left-then-right staged fill, duplicate-id fail-closed
